HOST-AUTHORITATIVE FOUNDATION

The Host owns movement, HP, damage, collisions, status effects, cooldown validation, projectile outcomes and round results. Guest controls remain inputs only. No enemy AI or boss progression runs in PvP. Hitbox Sync: cast lanes and hurtboxes stay locked to authoritative positions while characters move and animate.
